pr_body:
Previously basisu was storing mip maps as an array of basisu in the internal format for Texture. The new work makes sense and it generates smaller files with one image.

This pull request fixes the basisu decompression and keeps the approach of 1 image. If we need to change the format in 4.x, we can still support the old format with some limitations too.

Basisu from gltfpack can only output with mipmaps in one image.

The single image will not work for StreamedTexture. We should support both approaches for CompressedTexture we use one, and for StreamedTexture we use another.

Supersedes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/73857
Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/72237
pr_comments: As a side note for future work (post 4.0): `register_types.cpp` should only be used for some general registration code. Actual implementation of compression/decompression should be moved to `image_compress_basisu.cpp` or similar.

Regarding the issue rename.

Godot Engine calls this type of import an image import, similar to PNG and WEBP. The code in CompressedTexture2D is unmodified, but is related.

issue_context.title: Textures using Basis Universal compression no longer generate mipmaps
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.beta.custom_build [a43db5afa]

### System information

Windows 10, Forward+, NVidia RTX 3070 (516.94)

### Issue description

After recompiling the engine, a grid texture using Basis Universal compression in a test project became extremely noisy, having lost its mipmaps.

Opening a Basis Universal texture in the inspector shows that there are no mips, even if Generate Mipmaps is enabled:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43602802/215256078-ed1a203b-5455-413c-bb31-559acee1b812.png)
![editor_screenshot_2023-01-28T184045](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43602802/215256370-9b1278cf-c8f3-4356-94ea-b98d509ad895.png)


### Steps to reproduce

1. Import a texture to a project (The noisier the better).
2. Open texture in the inspector, enable mipmaps, change the compression mode to Basis Universal, and re-import.

### Minimal reproduction project

[Basis Universal MipMapping.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/10526818/Basis.Universal.MipMapping.zip)
comments: We wanted to use the basisu generated mipmaps rather than 5-12 images with each a basisu mipmap, but clearly it is bugged.

Here's some commentary about the fix for this pr. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/73857#issuecomment-1445120102

We wish to cherrypick the fix from 4.1.

review_comments:
Might be a good idea to add some checks that `Image::get_image_mipmap_size` matches the decoded size of this basisu level (something from `info`, `struct basisu_image_level_info` defined in `thirdparty/basis_universal/transcoder/basisu_transcoder.h` )

Note that at some mipmap levels, width and height might not be a multiple of 4, but the data will still be a multiple of blocks.

You could imagine potentially decoding a ktx file made with different mipmap levels, since (I believe) there is no requirement that all mipmap levels exist, and a malicious or incompatible ktx file might crash godot in such a case.

(It's just a suggestion, but I understand not having time to implement this today... we should come back and add these checks in the future especially when we implement [KHR_texture_basisu](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/blob/master/extensions/2.0/Khronos/KHR_texture_basisu/README.md) in gltf.
